comparison_design: Model3 source complete three-locus genetic state and demographic census held unchanged; visitor state replaced only in ephemeral reproduce_kb ledger and finite signed β/Gamma calculations at each pre-reproduction N6–9 state, never fed to population.advance
scientific_inference: Within this one source Model3 reproduction ledger, visitor availability/trait assemblage causally alters the instantaneous individual-minus-group seed payoff sign at identical N and diploid genotype (under an artificial experimental intervention), restoring source β<0/Gamma_seed>0 conflict in 835/1533 source states; this is not an independent ecological replication or evidence of persistent multi-generational population effects.
limitations: All 1533 paired source-year states come from only 96 observed simulated trajectories driven by 16 original stochastic visitor history RNG seeds, not 1533 independent ecological histories.

The four visitor types are hand-authored; intervention changes number and trait identity of visitors simultaneously. Do not attribute causal effect to richness alone or to recruitment of actual pollinators.
Within-year signed slopes are finite one-adult log W derivatives and group log viable-seed derivatives, not selection on new mutations, long-term allele trajectories or survival probabilities.
Visitor replacement is used only for counterfactual reproduction ledger evaluation; no future visitor population, genotype evolution, female lifetime fitness, density or N80 trajectory is changed.
The program's existing first-year externality mechanism is supported, but no conservation or evolutionary commons tragedy survival outcome is proven.
